notes.title: New Main Menu for the Game!
notes.notes:
[h3][/h3][p]Greetings, everyone![/p][p]The development of the major update for my game is in full swing, and I’m excited to share some fresh news with you. Today, I’ve finished working on the [b]new and improved main menu[/b] — it's now more user-friendly and visually appealing![/p][p]This is a big step toward the next version of the game, and I can’t wait for you to experience it yourself.[/p][p]📽️ Check out a short video on our YouTube channel to see the update in action.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="g4bESgAgHbk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Thank you for your continued support and interest in the project![/p]

notes.title: Development News!
notes.notes:
[p]📢 [b]Development News![/b]
Hi there!
I’ve noticed a spike in game sales — looks like you felt it coming: a big update is on the horizon.
Thank you for your trust and support ❤️[/p][h3]What I’ve been doing over the past year since the last Steam update:[/h3][list][*][p]Thinking. Strangely enough, thinking really helps to understand what the game truly needs.[/p][/*][*][p]I decided not just to add new arenas, but to [b]completely rebuild the game[/b] — deeper, more beautiful, more interesting.[/p][/*][*][p]I started from scratch — created a brand new project in Unity 6.[/p][/*][/list][h3]What’s already done:[/h3][list][*][p]The first new arena: [b]"Zombies in the Metro"[/b]
The player finds themselves in a speeding train. The goal is to reach the front car and stop the train before it crashes. But the way is blocked by [b]bloodthirsty zombies[/b]...[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]"Tower of Fear"[/b] arena has been completely overhauled. The mechanics remain the same, but the visuals are [b]many times better[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]"Wild West"[/b] arena has also been entirely rebuilt with improved visuals and atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][h3]What’s happening now:[/h3][p]I’m finishing a new arena — [b]"Prison Escape"[/b]
It’s my take on a battle royale, focusing on [b]smart AI opponents[/b] and intense escape mechanics.[/p][p]Next comes the [b]new main menu[/b], followed by the next [b]Steam update[/b].
Expected release: [b]within three weeks[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p]📍 [b]What’s next?[/b][/p][p]There will be a total of [b]15 arenas[/b].[/p][p]Visuals are already ready for:[/p][list][*][p][b]CQB Arena - Special Forces Training Base[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]"Skeleton Attack"[/b], where the player will use a wand to cast real magic[/p][/*][/list][p]This update will be released by [b]mid-August[/b].[/p][p]Then comes more ambitious content:
A [b]flying arena[/b] — I really liked the test mechanics, and soon our environment artist will begin building it.[/p][p]The [b]"Save Cubic City"[/b] arena will return too — in a reworked version, focusing on [b]horizontal movement[/b]. Concepts are drawn and ready to go.[/p][p]We’re also preparing:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]sports boxing arena[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cosmic battles[/b] at a lunar factory with insane robots[/p][/*][*][p]And even [b]working on an egg-harvesting conveyor line[/b] — something a bit unusual 😉[/p][/*][/list][p]I truly hope to impress you with how I reimagine the [b]Enigma cipher machine[/b] — what started as simple typing is turning into a deep and thrilling puzzle experience.[/p][p]Thank you for your support!
Stay tuned — lots of exciting things ahead 🎮[/p]

notes.title: The game's May 28 update.
notes.notes:
- New main menu. Try to find the exit from the program.

notes.title: Project Enigma
notes.notes:
A new mini-game in our Falling Down XR VR game collection.
Enigma Interactive Cipher Machine.
Press buttons, flash lights, send screenshots of the cipher to your friends and girlfriends, let them try to understand what you told them.
[previewyoutube=wL9oYyJHQ8k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Very soon a new mini game - Enigma cipher machine
notes.notes:
VR is the place where it is interesting to click the keys and look at the light bulbs that light up.
That's why we've added an interactive Enigma machine to Falling Down XR.

Three rotors, a reflector and a clever system of cables are ready to encrypt your message to your friend or girlfriend, let them decipher it before the sun goes out.
And while you are waiting for the game update in Stim, install a new screensaver on your computer screen, it looks just awesome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629032/af2bed19d1febf2af0f5a46549f25c54fe79ebfc.png[/img]

notes.title: Added a new level Wild West
notes.notes:
After a short break, we are starting our monthly update of our game.
Today we have added a new level Wild West.
This is a gift for those who missed the juicy shooting at moving enemies.

The original way of reloading the revolver.
Press the grip and twist the gun along the longitudinal axis, a sharp movement of the hand. The drum will fall out, then make a reverse movement, the drum with new cartridges will stand in place, continue to shoot.
We warn you right away, they kill quickly.

notes.title: A little Falling Down XP update and development plans.
notes.notes:
From now on your enemies try to hit you in the head, aiming from around the corner has become more dangerous, a deadly fireball is sure to arrive.

Let's talk about the near future, our game is a collection of VR attractions, the release of the game on sale is only the first step, in the near future we plan to add to the list of attractions, another game, flying on wings, invented an interesting and unusual mechanics. The game is planned at once in competitive multiplayer mode. But before that we will release additionally an expansion of levels for playing with friends. Level Tower of Fear, will be supplemented with a 4-player competition, who will pass the maze faster, and in the level Iron Rain, we will add the possibility of cooperative monster hunting, up to 4 people.

notes.title: We continue to enrich the game with new features.
notes.notes:
There is only a week left before the game releases, but we are not sitting idly by and continue to enrich the game with new features.


1.	Increased the number of bonuses for shootouts with ghosts in the cathedral. To the existing bonus that enhances the player's health, we added two new bonuses:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629032/ad38f875cb8da973b4e5a4788942f9d351369f62.png[/img]
•	Shield for the second hand, deflect enemy attacks while aiming at the opponent with the other hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629032/be3470dccf2e21505071c9734c09fb80474fb7a0.png[/img]
•	Temporary weapon swap to two of the most powerful handguns. Sometimes, when hordes of enemies are attacking and are about to overcome you, a bonus that allows you to get the two most powerful handguns for a few tens of seconds will come in very handy!

[i]We remind you that to activate a bonus, you need to shoot at it, and to get a different weapon, you need to "grab it with your hand".[/i]

2.	Added three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Hard is the old norm))). On easy difficulty levels, the damage is reduced and the health bonus is increased. To balance players in the leaderboard, the rewards earned for completing the game on easy difficulty levels are proportionally reduced. We hope we managed to find a delicate balance between the game's difficulty and the reward for success in it.

3.	Added FPS limit settings to the menu: 72, 90, 120, 240 frames per second. The video card will stop calculating 1300 frames per second and will rest if its power allows. Global warming is no joke, we are playing games, not mining bitcoin.

4.	On the first launch of the game or by selecting an item in the loading menu, you can get to the level familiarizing you with the game mechanics, here you will be told how to control the player and will be introduced to basic mechanics, i.e. in-game interactions, like how to jump on platforms, how to get a bonus, etc.

5.	Fixed minor translation errors, adjusted the balance, etc.

notes.title: New platform generation algorithm for the first level.
notes.notes:
We hurry to share news about fixes and enhancements:
[olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629032/e5e0a3ee37f378d0eea249171b90c7f841e37b4c.png[/img]
[*] New algorithm of platform generation for the first level. 
The distribution of platforms and bonuses after the start of the game became more dense, it became easier to finish the level, the main thing is to keep an eye on health and replenish it in time.

[*] Increased the damage to the enemy with your weapon.
It seems to have tightened the nuts, and then shootouts became too short, the player is killed immediately, and we promised more fan less sweat. Fixes.

[*] Changed the formula for calculating CQB points.
Reduced the influence of obstacle course time, otherwise 1000 points could only be scored by a record-breaking sprinter.
[/olist]

notes.title: October will see the release of our first VR game , Falling Down XR
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629032/94a48a9afc71ca24259387a01318ddec7d5e65f7.png[/img]

The game consists of several mini-games:

1. Platformer - by moving your feet and jumping from platform to platform, try to get to the cherished finish line in the least amount of time. The platforms will move, so fun is guaranteed!

2. Labyrinth - a bloodthirsty villain imprisoned you at the top of the tower, go through the maze and descend to freedom.

3. shooting gallery and ghost hunting - what VR project is without exciting shooting.
First practice in the shooting range and obstacle course, and then go to the old cathedral to fight with magical ghosts.

notes.title: Updated in-game control interface.
notes.notes:
Updated in-game control interface.
To make it easier to control the game, we have built in several features.
- Auto Pistol Charge, you don't want to be distracted in the heat of battle by reloading your weapon? One click in the settings and now you have access to infinite ammunition, with automatic loading them into the gun magazine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629032/1fc92d00dfe6bb34c02cbfe9d462fbc7fe87f7ed.gif[/img]
- Pop-up personalized menu on the turn of your hand. Add sound? Switch tracks? See your current health or level points?
No need to press buttons, just turn your hand as if you were looking at your wristwatch!
